description_en: Queries the Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) status of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的透明数据加密TDE的加密状态
name: DescribeDBInstanceTDE

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

Database.description_en:
The list of database-level TDE statuses.
For SQL Server 2019 Standard Edition, 2022 Standard Edition, 2025 Standard Edition, and SQL Server Enterprise instances, you can enable or shutdown TDE at the database level when TDE is enabled at the instance level
Database.description_zh:
数据库级别的TDE状态列表。
对于SQL Server 2019标准版、2022标准版、2025标准版和SQL Server企业版实例，可以在实例级别的TDE开启时，控制数据库级别的TDE开启或关闭

items.description_zh: 数据库级别的TDE状态详情

TDEStatus.description_en:
The database-level TDE status. Valid values:
Enabled
Disabled
TDEStatus.description_zh:
数据库级别的TDE状态，取值：
Enabled
Disabled

EncryptionKey.description_en: The ID of the key used for TDE encryption

TDEMode.description_en:
The key mode of instance-level TDE encryption. Valid values:
Aliyun_Generate_Key
Customer_Provided_Key
Unknown
TDEMode.description_zh:
实例级别的TDE加密的密钥方式，取值：
Aliyun_Generate_Key
Customer_Provided_Key
Unknown

TDEStatus.description_en:
